questions.question: What do Americans eat for Thanksgiving?
questions.explanation: Turkey is the traditional Thanksgiving food in America.

questions.question: What does "Trick or treat" mean?
options: Give me candy or I will play a trick
questions.explanation: On Halloween, children say "Trick or treat" to get candy.

questions.question: When do Americans open Christmas presents?
questions.explanation: In the UK and USA, presents are opened on Christmas Day (December 25th).

questions.question: What is Guy Fawkes Night?
options: A British celebration with fireworks on November 5th
questions.explanation: Guy Fawkes Night is celebrated in the UK on November 5th with bonfires and fireworks.
